name: Who Watches the Watchers Multi-Task Anomaly Detection Benchmark
description: A multi-task benchmark designed to evaluate anomaly detection methods across multiple tasks and data modalities.
reputation: Moderately cited academic benchmark for multi-task, multimodal anomaly detection research, with usage mainly in research settings rather than widespread industrial adoption.
notes: Heterogeneous modalities and severe class imbalance; performance can be sensitive to preprocessing and label noise. Small/varied task datasets in the suite make cross-task aggregation challenging. Non-LLM benchmark focused on classical and deep anomaly-detection methods.
